 Blockx withdraws from Paris with an ankle injury, Baez enters as a lucky loser 
 Cédric Rouquette 
 November 2, 2026 
 The Belgian, ranked No. 28, is replaced by Sebastian Baez, beaten in the final qualifying round on Sunday, who faces Daniel Merida on Court 2 on Monday.
 Rolex Paris Masters 
 Alexander Blockx has withdrawn from the Rolex Paris Masters with an ankle injury. He is replaced in the main draw by Sebastian Baez , who enters as a lucky loser.
 Baez, the top seed in qualifying, had lost to Tomas Machac 6-2, 6-4 in the final qualifying round on Sunday. He takes Blockx’s place against Daniel Merida , third match on Court 2 on Monday . The winner will face 12th seed Tommy Paul or Holger Rune in the second round.
 Blockx, 21 and ranked No. 28, had already withdrawn from Brussels and Vienna with an ankle injury. He has not won a match since his run to the US Open quarter-finals.
